basis: NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory Enterprise RA (2026-03) §2 Racks, 36 Trays with 144 Blackwell Ultra GPUs (dual-plane rail-optimized topology)

power_a.spec: Pod Busway A (recommended 384 kW+ provisioning for 2x SU + switches)

tcs_supply.spec: Parallel TCS supply manifold feeding SU-1 and SU-2

tcs_return.spec: Parallel TCS return manifold from SU-1 and SU-2

air_in.spec: Front cold-aisle intake (2x SU residual air + 1x network switch rack)

spine_ew_uplink.spec: 8x SN5610 dual-plane leaf uplinks to Spine layer (for 4-SU / 8-SU expansion)

core_ns_uplink.spec: 2x SN5610 converged N-S uplinks to storage & customer core

core_oob_uplink.spec: 2x100G HA OOB uplinks to management core

limitations: 三柜居中网络柜排布（SU-1 | Network | SU-2）可使叶交换机到两台算力柜的高速链路长度最小化；实际机房采用列端网络柜（EoR）时须按 PEX 提取真实线长复核光/铜选型。
